definition: The type of the first author's first listed affiliation, by the first matching rule in taxonomy/affiliation_rules.csv: regulator, CRO, vendor, industry or academia; unclassified where no rule matches; no affiliation where the record gives none. PAGE uses the numbered affiliation line with its fallbacks (classifyFirstAuthor())

The name a naming rule matched in the first author's affiliation (a company, CRO, vendor or regulator, as written in the text); empty otherwise. Other organisation names are not published (decided 2026-10-20) and stay in the local cache
TRUE where any author's institution is of type industry
TRUE where any author's institution is of type CRO
The names matched by rules that name organisations (companies, CROs, vendors, regulators), as written in the text, joined by '; '
Organisations not stored: those decided by the consultancy rule (often named after a person) and those containing a word of the item's author list
